dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: There's a lot of news in Mondstadt, but the information in The Cat's Tail should sell better...

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Are you looking for a game too? Awesome! I hope you'll give me "exclusive news on an outstanding player!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: No problem! There will always be more opportunities in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: Awesome! I've got my "exclusive news on an outstanding player" now!

dialogues.speaker: Paban
dialogues.text: I think I understand how it feels to play with someone in The Cat's Tail... This information is quite valuable indeed!
